title: Can Explanations Improve Recommendations? Evidence from Prediction-Informed Explanations
abstract: arXiv:2502.16759v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recommender systems are central to digital platforms, yet they face a fundamental trade-off between accuracy and explainability: Black-box models achieve strong performance but lack interpretability needed for trust and adoption, while existing explainable AI approaches often generate explanations post hoc or sacrifice accuracy. We challenge this view, proposing that explanations, when designed as an integral component of the system and aligned with predictions, can improve \emph{both} interpretability and accuracy. We introduce RecPIE (Recommendation with Prediction-Informed Explanations), a framework that jointly optimizes recommendation predictions and natural-language explanations. RecPIE embeds explanation generation into the learning loop: predictions guide explanation generation (prediction-informed explanations), which are fed back to refine subsequent predictions (explanation-informed predictions) via alternating training. T

translated_title: 解释能否改善推荐效果？来自预测引导式解释的证据
translated_abstract: 推荐系统是数字平台的核心，但它们面临准确性与可解释性之间的根本性权衡：黑盒模型虽然性能强大，却缺乏建立用户信任与采纳所需的解释能力，而现有的可解释AI方法往往只能在事后生成解释，或者以牺牲准确性为代价。我们挑战了这一传统观点，提出当解释被设计为系统的内在组成部分并与预测保持一致时，可以同时提升可解释性和准确性。我们提出了RecPIE（基于预测引导解释的推荐框架），这是一个联合优化推荐预测与自然语言解释的框架。RecPIE将解释生成嵌入到学习循环中：预测引导解释的生成（预测引导式解释），解释再通过交替训练反馈回来以优化后续预测（解释引导式预测）。
tldr: 该论文提出RecPIE框架，将自然语言解释生成嵌入推荐学习循环，通过预测引导解释、解释反馈优化预测的交替训练机制，同时提升推荐的准确性与可解释性。
en_tdlr: RecPIE is a framework that jointly optimizes recommendation predictions and natural-language explanations by embedding explanation generation into the learning loop—predictions guide explanation generation, which is fed back to refine predictions through alternating training—thereby improving both accuracy and interpretability.
